How the phases of the Moon change

The Moon does not shine by itself: we see the part of it that is lit by the Sun. As it goes around the Earth, the angle between the Sun, the Earth and the Moon changes, and a different share of its lit half is seen from the Earth. Those are the phases.

The full cycle from one new moon to the next (the synodic month) lasts 29 days, 12 hours and 44 minutes on average. After the new moon the Moon waxes: a thin crescent in the western evening sky, the first quarter after about a week and the full moon after about two. Then it wanes through the last quarter to the next new moon. From the northern hemisphere the waxing Moon is lit on the right and the waning Moon on the left.

The distance to the Moon changes too, because its orbit is an ellipse: from about 356,000 km at perigee to about 406,000 km at apogee. When a full moon falls near perigee the Moon looks a little larger and brighter, which is called a "supermoon".

Frequently asked questions about the Moon

When is the next full moon and new moon?

The next full moon is on 24 November 2026, 16:53 and the next new moon on 9 December 2026, 02:51 (Bulgarian time).

How long is the lunar cycle?

From one new moon to the next takes 29 days, 12 hours and 44 minutes on average. This is called the synodic month. The time between two new moons can be a few hours shorter or longer, because the Moon's orbit is an ellipse.

Why does the Moon have phases?

The Moon does not shine by itself, it reflects sunlight. As it goes around the Earth, a different part of its lit half is seen from here: from a thin crescent through the first quarter and the full moon to the last quarter and the new moon again.

What is a supermoon?

A supermoon is a full moon that coincides with perigee, the closest point of the Moon's orbit (about 356,000 km, against 406,000 km at apogee). It looks up to about 14% larger and 30% brighter than the farthest full moon.

What is a blue moon?

A blue moon is the second full moon in one calendar month. It is not blue in colour. There is no blue moon in these two years.
